summary: Two Palestinians were injured in two separate incidents when settlers threw stones at Palestinian vehicles.
discovery_sources: OCHA Protection of Civilians 14-27 Mar 2023; PLO NAD Daily Situation Report 20 Mar 2023; WAFA 20 Mar 2023; PLO NAD Daily Situation Report 27 Mar 2023
resolution_notes: The Mar. 19 component is now materially resolved at event level: NAD explicitly records an evening 03/19/2023 settler stone-throwing attack on Al-Maarajat Road, connecting Jericho and Ramallah, injuring Munir Ahmed Abdullah Mur; WAFA, posted 00:11 on Mar. 20, independently reports the same named victim, road, masked-settler vehicle stoning and injuries that night. This removes the earlier apparent Mar.19/20 conflict and matches OCHA's Mar.19 road-near-Ramallah component without allocating any other aggregate count by guesswork. The Mar. 27/Deir Istiya half remains unresolved: NAD's daily reporting window spans Mar.26-27 and its monthly account dates the same named-victim incident Mar.26, while OCHA says Mar.27. Keep the aggregate candidate Unresolved until that second component is safely dated/deduplicated; no canonical acceptance/publication chain triggered this run.
media_status: No exact incident media recovered for either component; no generic imagery used.
